content: MK's biography says that in 830/1427 the Hurufi Aḥmad-i Lur attacked Shāhrukh as he left the congregational mosque in Herat and was killed on the spot; Shāhrukh then arrested prominent figures with suspected Hurufi ties, Qāsim-i Anvār, Maʿrūf-i Khaṭṭāt, Ṣāʾin al-Dīn and others; Ṣāʾin al-Dīn, who had just left Herat, was called back, imprisoned, stripped of position and property, tortured, then exiled.
refers_to_primary: MK, Chapter 1 (citing Binbaş, 'The Anatomy of an Attempted Regicide')
